recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片可見染色質疏鬆的巨母紅血球前驅細胞、核出芽／碎裂成多個小葉的紅血球母細胞（dyserythropoiesis），以及吞噬核碎屑的巨噬細胞（無效造血），右側有巨大後髓細胞，符合 B12 缺乏的巨母細胞變化。
features: Megaloblastic erythroid precursors with open, finely granular chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Erythroblast with multilobated/budding nucleus (nuclear fragmentation) indicating dyserythropoiesis
Macrophage containing multiple round purple nuclear debris fragments (ineffective erythropoiesis)
Giant metamyelocyte/band with large horseshoe-shaped nucleus at right edge
Background red cells with anisocytosis including macrocytes
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows megaloblastic erythroid precursors with finely dispersed chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm. Dyserythropoiesis is evident, including an erythroblast with a multilobated, budding nucleus. A macrophage contains phagocytosed nuclear debris, reflecting intramedullary cell death, and a giant granulocytic precursor is seen at the edge. Background red cells show anisocytosis with macrocytes. Findings are consistent with megaloblastic anemia with dyserythropoiesis, as in vitamin B12 deficiency.

ddx.vs: MDS dyserythropoiesis is accompanied by ring sideroblasts, hypolobated megakaryocytes or pseudo-Pelger neutrophils rather than giant metamyelocytes, and vitamin levels are normal.
CDA shows binucleated/multinucleated late erythroblasts and internuclear bridges in younger patients, without giant granulocytic precursors.
Leukemia shows sheets of pronormoblasts with a maturation arrest rather than megaloblastic maturation.
